text: {"requester":{"id":"lab-op-0142","cls":"operator"},"campaign_name":"oer_nimnfe_thermal_screen_v2","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before deposition"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,10,0,20,0,0,20,40,0,0,0,10],"thickness":120},"comment":"Ni-rich NiFeMn baseline, standard thickness"},{"server":"thermal_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":180,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard crystallization anneal, within substrate spec"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"re-index plate after thermal step"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,10,0,20,0,0,20,40,0,0,0,10],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2 for overpotential"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,10,0,20,0,0,20,40,0,0,0,10],"duration":24},"comment":"short stability check"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{},"comment":"update GP surrogate with new point"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{},"comment":"select next composition"}]}
